Completed alignment, builds, audits and original-image qualification remain accepted; the next changed image receives its own qualification.

RG35XX SP accepted15:24UTC, RG SP15:54UTC, Nova16:01UTC, followed by final preservation/frame review. Every original stage/reboot result channel is0 and actual owners exited. Both additional devices have been handed back for normal use. Those deployment/build/audit jobs have ended. The #529 VM investigation is complete; its source delta and next-candidate qualification are recorded below. Nova startup observations are retained under #344: one recovered frontend retry also occurs on the prior build; the early SMMU burst is not assigned a cause or frequency. No physical gameplay/audio claim.

## Audit-discovered follow-up

From #603 verified blind/refutation review, G-11. Severity: Medium.

Exact ES16dbac GameCubeRvzHashRetry.h returns true for empty/invalid/all-zero hashes whenever the GameCube-only RVZ mapping and no-positive-ID conditions hold. ThreadedHasher326–327 queues it and227 forces rehash; FileData2182–2184 persists the same failure sentinel. No attempt/file-version marker or cooldown ends repeated automatic work. Valid nonzero unmatched hashes are already preserved and must stay so. Runtime cost is unmeasured; do not present this as the cause of the owner browser slowdown.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Synthetic isolated fixtures can exercise these paths without a handheld, personal library, credentials or provider account. Runtime requires a fresh root-owned serialized allocation with original exits and bounded cleanup.

Already written: preserve existing player files and historical original results. No deployed owner state is repaired or erased by filing this task.

Owner: M7 integrator. Priority: before a subsequent affected-device release/deployment; exact H700 applicability is checked separately under #344/D-WORKFLOW-168. No public RC waiver.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Current-source VM controls distinguish a supported old failure, permanent unsupported/malformed input, transient read failure, and valid unmatched/positive-ID metadata with exact original outcomes.
- [ ] Unchanged permanent failures do not trigger repeated expensive automatic reads on each indexing start; explicit retry and a changed file or reader version can retry according to a documented policy.
- [ ] Existing valid IDs/hashes, account separation, queue/cursor and startup limits remain unchanged; installed frontend proof and exact-source unchanged-flow evidence precede pin promotion.
